name: Viva Piñata
description: Piñatas of various species roam the Piñata Island gardens freely, eating candy and coexisting with one another in a peaceful society. When a piñata's candy inside reaches a high enough level, they are sent to a party, where they will be broken open by the partygoers before being repaired and returned to the island. The series follows a group of close piñata friends and their day-to-day lives on the island.

videos.title: Cocoadile Tears
videos.overview: Fergy, Franklin, Les and Paulie must help their friends, Tina and Teddington Twingersnap to make a beautiful garden, but they must get help from Chortles Chippopotamus. Can his advice help Tina & Teddington?

videos.title: Candiosity
videos.overview: Fergy refuses to go to a party that he is scheduled for. Will the "all-knowing" Bonboon help him get past his fear, and help him lower his Candiosity?

videos.title: Queen For A Day
videos.overview: Franklin begins planting buttercups, trying to get honey for himself. Soon, trouble occurs when the Buzzlegums come along. Will Franklin be able to handle the overwhelming number of Buzzlegums?

videos.title: A Chewnicorn in the Garden
videos.overview: A Chewnicorn in the Garden: Fergy and Franklin try to convince Pauly that Chewnicorns do exist, and in order to do so, they must catch one by planting Gem Trees. Can Fergy and Franklin prove Paulie wrong, or are Chewnicorns a figment of imagination?

videos.title: Legs
videos.overview: Legs: Fergy wants to enter a dance competition, but can't because his legs break. He is forced to use a spare pair of legs that resemble an ostrich. Can he Cluckle-scratch his way to victory, regardless of his new legs?

videos.title: Horstachio of a Different Color
videos.overview: Horstachio of a Different Color: A new Horstachio comes along, and he enters the Horastachio Competition that Hudson has won four years in a row. Will his winning streak die down, now that a new Horastachio is in town?

videos.title: Whirlm With A Dream
videos.overview: Wilson Whirlm dreams of being blasted off to kids' party, whereas Fergy will do anything to avoid it. Can Hudson Horstachio teach him how to be a real party animal, or is Fergy doomed to go to a party?

videos.title: The Crush
videos.overview: Paulie and Fergy ask the short-term memory Ella Elephanilla to the Dance of Romance, unbeknownst to each other. Can either ONE of them go to the dance with Ella, and why is Franklin helping both of them with the situation?

videos.title: Trojan Horstachio
videos.overview: Professor Pester and his henchmen disguise themselves as a female horstachio in order to trap Hudson. Hudson immediately falls in love with the new horstachio, but insists on showing her everything about him and his life. Pester will need to create a love greater than Hudson's love for himself if he hopes to capture him.

videos.title: The Piñatas Must Be Crazy!
videos.overview: When the Great Bonboon tricks the piñatas into believing a balloon animal is actually PIÑATOR, a supreme being with a sweet tooth, it's up to Paulie to prevent the Bonboon from conning his friends out of all their candy.

videos.title: Franklin Can't Dance
videos.overview: Franklin meets Florence Fizzlybear and she wants to dance with him, and Franklin is the worst dancer in the world, but Hudson, Fergy, Paulie, and Ella tell her otherwise. Now Franklin must undergo dance training. But what happens when the music can't be played for Franklin?

videos.title: Lights, Camera, Action!
videos.overview: Professor Pester kidnaps the piñatas disguised as Reg Upchuck to trick them into being in a movie, but Paulie smells a rat. Will Paulie save his friends, or will Professor Pester beat them to smithereens.

videos.title: Sick Day
videos.overview: All the piñatas except Fergy are sick, so Fergy cares for them and eats their "sneeze candy" so he can get sick and not have to attend a party. But his plan backfires, when he doesn't get sick, and is the only Piñata healthy enough to go to a party. Can he find a way out of this?

videos.title: Les Saves the Day... Again!
videos.overview: It's time for the Annual Beach Blanket Blowout Bash, but there is a volcano erupting near it and Les Galagoogoo is the only one who knows about it, and no one understands him! Can he save everyone, and at least have everyone know about it?

videos.title: Mad Mongo
videos.overview: Franklin and his friends discover a Sour Macaraccoon, who they call "Mongo," and Franklin decides to tame him. Will he be able to tame him in time for the ritziest social event in all of Piñata Island?

videos.title: Hudson's Biggest Fan
videos.overview: After meeting Beverly Badgesicle, his biggest fan, Hudson tries hard to shake her off, despite her devotion and obsessive behavior. Can Franklin's help finally help Hudson get some privacy from his biggest fan?

videos.title: Mission: Impiñatable
videos.overview: When Hudson gets captured by Professor Pester, he thinks the new lair is a new night club, and thinks he doesn't need rescuing. Can his "rescue team" get their act together and save someone who thinks he doesn't need saving?

videos.title: My Little Fergy
videos.overview: Fergy's mother, Francine Fudgehog, comes to visit, and learning of what she told Langston, he decides to send him to a party, just so Fergy can make his mother proud. Can he actually handle it, or will he go to pieces?

videos.title: The Great Gob Rush
videos.overview: Fergy Fudgehog finds a hidden cave filled with golden caramel clusters. But it’s more than that, when Professor Pester and the Ruffians plant the gobs in the cave, as a trap? Can the Piñatas escape, or will victory be Pester’s?

videos.title: Hero
videos.overview: When Franklin saves Hudson's life, he's been hailed as a famous hero, but what happens when the modest Fizzlybear's fame soon eclipses Hudson's?

videos.title: On A Sour Note
videos.overview: When Franklin and friends form a rock band, the results are less than rockin'. That is, until a Sour Profitamole joins the group, then the wild sounds coming from this party animal really made it sound as it should. But when the Piñatas try to tame the wild musician, is their performance doomed to end on a sour note?

videos.title: Pig-Out Mountain
videos.overview: Hoping to avoid going to parties for the rest of his days, Fergy Fudgehog decides to join up with a group of Rashberry Alpine Climbers, and decides to drag a reluctant Paulie Pretztail along for the adventure. The climbers turn out to be thrill-seekers, and Fergy and Paulie end up having to go through trecherous conditions, just to get at the delicious bounty of food, supposedly said to be at the top of the mountain! Can they reach it before going to pieces, as well as another surprise that awaits them?

videos.title: Piñatapartyphobia
videos.overview: When Fergy's amazingly huge fear of parties goes out of control, it's up to Dr. Quackberry to cure him of the fear, by creating a simulation of Piñata Central. Fergy's rehersal flops, but how will Fergy fare when he ends up going to the real thing, as suggested by the good doctor?

videos.title: Royal Visit
videos.overview: When Fergy learns that a Piñata knighted by King Roario can do whatever he wants - including not going to any parties - He decides to concoct a phony list of heroic deeds, but the King sees through Fergy's cunning (or not so cunning) ruse. He decides to teach Fergy a lesson, by pretending there is a Dragonache that Fergy must slay.

videos.title: The Wraisins of Wrath
videos.overview: Fergy and Paulie bake pie for their friends, but the tasty raisins in the pie have a nasty side-effect, they cause a Piñata to behave in an opposite manner to their normal personality. Can Fergy and Paulie reverse the effects before the garden goes crazy?

videos.title: Piñata Island Idol
videos.overview: When Piñata Island's main dance hall collapses during a particularly exuberant night of dancing, the piñatas must somehow raise ten thousand candy coins to rebuild it. They decide to hold a talent show -- but when word of the show reaches Professor Pester, he decides to snare those ten thousand coins for himself. Will his dastardly plans succeed?

videos.title: To Catch a Piñata
videos.overview: When Langston Lickatoad suddenly vacates Piñata Island, Fergy applies for Langston's Piñata Wrangler job. After all, if Fergy's the official wrangler, in charge of picking who goes to what party, he’ll never have to actually attend one himself. But when the mysterious Piñata Central boss notices that Fergy's best friend Paulie Pretztail has never been to a single party, he orders Fergy to round Paulie up for immediate party-duty!

videos.title: Invasion of the Boogie Snatchers
videos.overview: Professor Pester uses hypnotic music to turn all the Piñatas on the island into mindless, obedient zombies so he can get all their candy. The only hope is Paulie’s annoying neighbor and nemesis, Spalding Sparrowmint. But can Paulie convince the stubborn, tone-deaf warbler to overcome their differences and save all the Piñatas?

videos.title: Candibalism
videos.overview: Unwilling to share his delicious, life-size chocolate bunnycomb with others, Fergy instead tries to pass it off as his visiting cousin, Candice. But unable to resist 'her' chocolatey charms, Fergy devours the bunnycomb whole. When the piñatas find a bloated Fergy beside the remains of the bunny's disguise, Fergy is arrested and put on trial for eating his own cousin!

videos.title: Pecky Pudgeon, Private Eye
videos.overview: When Ella Elephanilla calls reporter Pecky Pudgeon about a threatening letter, he comes to her home -- only to find her missing. This leads him on the trail of mystery as one by one, all his piñata acquaintances vanish. In the end, he finds and rescues Ella – and learns the astonishing secret behind the mystery.

videos.title: Rocket to Nowhere
videos.overview: To escape going to parties once and for all, Fergy gives the Bonboon all his candy in exchange for a trip on Bonboon’s rocket to another planet. The rocket ends up going nowhere - it’s a fake, of course - but Fergy’s fogged-up helmet makes him think Piñata Island is actually a strange, gassy planet. After confusing his friends for hostile aliens, Fergy desperately tries to get back to the rocket and return “home” before the “aliens” can stop him.

videos.title: Twingersnapped!
videos.overview: Late for their job as judges at a dance contest, the constantly bickering Tina and Teddington end up lost in the Jungle. A wild fall off a cliff results in them being split in two. At first, they enjoy their freedom -- but when they are captured by Professor Pester, they come to realize just how much they need each other.

videos.title: Franklingestion
videos.overview: Franklin Fizzlybear returns from Piñata duty at a party to discover that his insides are growing not candy, but vegetables! What happened to Franklin, and will he ever be the same?

videos.title: Confetti-itis
videos.overview: Franklin has a bad case of Confetti-itis. Dr. Quackberry gives Franklin a potion that seems to be clearing up his condition. In addition, it increases Franklin’s candy capacity!

videos.title: Soil and Green
videos.overview: Fergy and Paulie find a desolate hideout where they can avoid the Cannoñata, however, a Miracle farmer Whirlm named Wendell threatens to blow their cover by turning the hideout into a lush garden.

videos.title: I, Pretztail
videos.overview: When Paulie Pretztail discovers that Party Central has classified him as a Squazzil his self-image shatters. He embraces his ‘true’ heritage and moves in with his kin... but then (like all visiting relatives) Paulie proceeds to drive his new Squazzil family nuts! Can Fergy prove to Paulie that he really is a Pretztail before the Squazzils do their annoying new family member in?

videos.title: Free the Piñatas
videos.overview: Professor Pester convinces the pinatas to march on Pinata Central to tear down the Cannonata.

videos.title: For My Next Trick
videos.overview: When Franklin gets a new magic wand, Les gets drafted as his new magical assistant. Franklin becomes an incredible magician (thanks to Les secretly executing the tricks), and actually believes the wand has special powers. But, when Professor Pester tries to steal the wand, will Franklin’s own brand of magic be able to keep him away?

videos.title: Treasure of Piñata Madre
videos.overview: Franklin, Fergy, and Paulie discover a treasure chest from a saltwater taffy factory and Professor Pester seeks to take it for himself.

videos.title: Between a Flock and a Hard Place
videos.overview: Teddington insults a passing Goobaa, which gets its revenge by framing Teddy for vandalism. Can Teddy prove his innocence before the other Piñatas run him out of town—or worse?

videos.title: High Plains Drafter
videos.overview: A caricature artist named El Sketcho arrives and with his work, causes great damage to the confidence of the other Piñatas. As a result, Franklin comes out of caricature retirement to take El Sketcho down.

videos.title: Pester's Party
videos.overview: Professor Pester has a diabolical new scheme to capture pinatas and take their candy. Hacking into the Pinata Central computer, he resets the Cannonata's coordinates.

videos.title: Mouse Flap
videos.overview: Monty Mousemallow is a paranoid little pinata who always thinks that the other pinatas are out to get him. When Franklin Fizzlybear accidentally sits on Monty, Monty gets all riled up and wants to beat his fizzlybear behind!

videos.title: Snow Place Like Home
videos.overview: Paulie and Fergy decide to "retire" so that they will no longer have to worry about Langston. The Bonboon sells them land in a new "retirement paradise" called "Amazing Acres". But when our guys arrive, they discover that "Amazing Acres" is located in the frozen arctic tundra.

videos.title: The Abominable Jeli
videos.overview: On the far, arctic side of the island, our friends find themselves in the middle of the Great Snowball War, pitting a thousand penguins against one huge yeti.

videos.title: Mirror Shmirror
videos.overview: A freak cannonata accident blasts Franklin into an alternate universe – one where the garden is ruled by Spanklin, a goateed, evil version of Franklin. Can Franklin, together with the Overground Resistance, end his gnarly reign?

videos.title: My Pal Langston
videos.overview: Fergy’s tired of hiding from Langston to keep from being sent to parties. So Paulie and he devise a plan to get Langston to become Fergy’s best friend - because friends don’t make friends party if they don’t want to!

videos.title: Snail's Pace
videos.overview: Professor Pester recalls his early days, when he created the Sours to fulfill an evil plan. But evil plans have a way of going way wrong...

videos.title: Hudson On Hudson
videos.overview: When Hudson puts on a show with a miniature puppet of himself as the co-star, the two share their favourite moments in a trip down memory lane.

videos.title: Wild Horstachios
videos.overview: During a commercial shoot, Hudson accidentally ends up lost in the jungle with a pack of wild horstachios and must “rough it” for the first time in his life if he wants to survive. Being pampered and spoiled, this isn't easy.

videos.title: My Sweet Sours
videos.overview: Fergy and the gang have made it to the Finals of the Pinata Island Soccer tournament – despite having Shirley Shelleybelly (snail) on their team. But when a gang of thuggish fans kidnaps the opposing team and takes their place, it looks like certain doom for our favorite piñata team!

videos.title: Six Million Dollar Piñata
videos.overview: When Fergy wakes up to find his body blown to bits thanks to a freak mishap, Prewitt Profitamole rebuilds him with bionic parts. Fergy’s excited to be a super-piñata at first, but the novelty soon wears off when Fergy’s friends take advantage of his new powers eventually causing the bionics to short-circuit from overuse.

videos.title: A Terrible Tribute
videos.overview: Hudson is placed on a show called "This Here's Your Life", where he is met by different Piñatas from his past.

videos.title: Pester the Piñata
videos.overview: Professor Pester's plan to gain candy goes awry, resulting in him getting amnesia and thinking that he is a baby Piñata, with Fergy as his mother.

videos.title: Fudge Match
videos.overview: When an impressive Fudgehog named Flex comes to town, Fergy becomes jealous of him and races him to prove himself to his friends.

videos.title: Hudson's Holiday
videos.overview: After Hudson gets a twitch from stress due to being overworked, he is forced on vacation on a deserted island.

videos.title: Hudson Tells All
videos.overview: Hudson's angry rant against several Sweetooth workers gets recorded onto his talking doll by accident, offending the other Piñatas.

videos.title: Langston's Jameleon Cousins
videos.overview: Langston's three Jameleon cousins come to visit and pull pranks on Langston, befriending Fergy in the process.

videos.title: The Fudgetive
videos.overview: Fergy's plan goes awry when he tricks the Piñatas into believing he has been kidnapped by Professor Pester, who is currently on vacation.

videos.title: She Stomps At Night
videos.overview: Professor Pester's plan to seize candy involves luring a sleepwalking Ella to his lair, and Fergy and Paulie must do what they can to stop it.

videos.title: Les The Jet Setter
videos.overview: Fergy swallows Les's jetpack to hide it, and he uses it to avoid going to parties.

videos.title: Slayin' em at the Sands
videos.overview: Pester captures Paulie's cousins and performs a comedy routine to make them laugh until they lose their candy.

videos.title: Crimes of Passion Fruit
videos.overview: Fergy goes to the Big Boss of Piñata Central, finding that he is actually a bowl of fruit, and smashes him with a stapler.

videos.title: The Antlers are Blowin' in the Wind
videos.overview: Paulie and Fergy work with their new friend Machi Moojoo to escape from going to parties.

videos.title: Sumo Tsunami
videos.overview: Fergy becomes a sumo wrestler so he can gorge himself with food.

videos.title: Recipe for Disaster
videos.overview: Fergy and Paulie enter a cooking contest, facing Shirley Shellybean and Professor Pester for a lifetime supply of candy.

videos.title: Mr. Unbustable
videos.overview: Fergy works out at the gym so that he may become unbreakable at parties; however, his plan backfires when this turns him into a spectacle.

videos.title: Too Many Fergys
videos.overview: Fergy travels through a time portal, resulting in meeting himself from the previous day.

videos.title: Party Parasite
videos.overview: Hudson learns from Dr. Quackberry that he has a parasite that is eating up all of his candy.

videos.title: Hibernation Nation
videos.overview: Franklin invites his friends to a hibernation party in the mountains.

videos.title: The Old Pinatas Home
videos.overview: Fergy and his friends visit Fergy's uncle at a retirement home and decide that they need to spruce it up.

videos.title: Shirley Shells Out
videos.overview: Shirley is entered into a race, during which she is given a potion to her by Professor Pester that turns her into a Sour.

videos.title: The Transparent Trap
videos.overview: The Great Bonboon convinces Fergy that he has turned invisible after drinking his special tonic.

videos.title: To Catch A Pester
videos.overview: The Piñatas decide to lock up Professor Pester in their new jail, but wind up waiting on him hand and foot as a result.

videos.title: My Sweet Swanana
videos.overview: Fergy and Paulie set up Rory Rashberry on a date with Svetlana Swanana in hopes that Rory will move out of Paulie's house.

videos.title: Ella Forgets To Forget
videos.overview: Fergy sets up a service in which Piñatas can unload their secrets on Ella, since she always forgets what she is told; however, she begins to remember them.

videos.title: Motivational Beak
videos.overview: Langston enlists a drill sergeant to whip Fergy and Paulie into shape and force them to go to parties.

videos.title: Bringing Up Cluckle
videos.overview: Hudson begins a big brother program and finds himself taking care of a mother Cluckle's three children, one of them being a Dragonache.

videos.title: Beauty and the Beasts
videos.overview: Hudson hosts the Miss Piñata beauty pageant, but after meeting all three contestants he hates, he asks Fergy, Franklin, and Paulie to enter disguised as females.

videos.title: The Talented Mr. Hack
videos.overview: Hudson hires a hillbilly Horstachio named Hack to be his look-alike, but after feeling used, Hack imprisons Hudson and takes his place among the Piñatas.

videos.title: De-Mock-Racy
videos.overview: The Big Boss decides to hold elections for Langston's position as "Commander Guy", and Hudson emerges as the frontrunner

videos.title: Her Royal Forgetfulness
videos.overview: After learning that she is a queen, Fergy convinces Ella that he is her husband, the king, since royalty is exempt from going to parties. However, he soon begins to abuse his newfound power, So it's up to Hudson, Franklin, Paulie and Of Course, King Roario.

videos.title: The Wrong Stuff
videos.overview: Langston announces that Hudson will be sent to the first ever party on the moon, but it turns out to be Professor Pester's space station. So Langston, and and the gang must get Hudson back from Professor Pester.

videos.title: Pinatametermania
videos.overview: After a mix up at a movie theater, the Piñatas wind up with the wrong Piñatameters, resulting in each of them having the wrong job.

videos.title: Heads and Tails
videos.overview: A faulty Piñata repair robot known as the Assemblata causes Hudson's head to be placed on Fergy's body, and he is placed in a Freakata show by a circus ringmaster.

videos.title: Speechless
videos.overview: Tina loses her voice, allowing Teddington to pursue his terrible singing without her complaints.

videos.title: Good Clop, Bad Clop
videos.overview: When Hudson becomes a police officer, he arrests every Piñata on the island, including himself.

videos.title: Announce This
videos.overview: Hudson, Pierre, and Pecky compete for the position of commentator for the Party Animal Championships.

videos.title: Ruffians On Strike
videos.overview: After leading the Ruffians in a strike against Professor Pester for his cruel behavior, Hudson finds himself wanting to send the Ruffians back to their master.

videos.title: Zip It Good
videos.overview: Hudson takes a vow of silence after a crisis of self-indulgence.

videos.title: Tabloid For Two
videos.overview: When rumors of celebrity rivals Hudson and Hayley Horstachio being an item are spread by their agents which upsets Beverly Badgesicle, the two are forced into a wedding despite hating each other.

videos.title: All Spun Out
videos.overview: Professor Pester opens the spinning Red Hot nightclub in a scheme to draw in all of the Piñatas and make them lose their candy.

videos.title: Arctic Invasion
videos.overview: A popular band named "The Pengums" takes Piñata Central by storm, prompting Hudson and Langston to work together to get rid of them.

videos.title: Say Uncle Hoofy
videos.overview: Hudson and Fergy discover that Fergy's mother Francine and Hudson's uncle Hoofy are now married, and the two of them fight over who is the "favorite son."

videos.title: A Match Made In Court
videos.overview: Hudson has been sent to Court by Beverly for avoiding her and Langston rewards her with an Attaining Order.

videos.title: Hudson's Better Half
videos.overview: Hayley Horstachio and her all-female team face Hudson's all-male team in an obstacle course championship challenge, but a twist soon has them competing to lose rather than win.

videos.title: Hudsonly Ever After
videos.overview: Finding himself unable to sleep, Hudson tells his dummy the story of Hansel and Gretel, but decides there isn't enough of himself in it.

videos.title: Hudson Who-Stachio?
videos.overview: Hudson falls into a personal crisis after being ignored by kids at a party.

videos.title: The Horstachio Who Never Was
videos.overview: Fearing Pester will kidnap Hudson, Langston gives Hudson a new identity. However, Hudson makes himself a third identity that the others might prefer to the original.

videos.title: Fergy Drops Out
videos.overview: After Langston initiates a party reeducation course for the entire island, Fergy and Paulie flee to the desert, where they find a group of free spirit Chocstriches who reject parties. Since Fergy has never been to a party, they declare him their master.

videos.title: Super Hero Hudson
videos.overview: Hudson gains superpowers after accidentally licking a meteorite that lands in his bathtub, and so he becomes Super Hud. However, after Super Hud becomes overbearing, Hudson's friends conspire with Professor Pester to get him to stop.

videos.title: The Amazing Hudini
videos.overview: In order to revive his career, Hudson seeks to become a stunt performer, and goes to a retired impossiblist named Blaine Bunnycomb to learn the ropes.

videos.title: Variations On A Theme Park
videos.overview: Rodney Raisant's attempts to build an amusement park named RodneyLand are repeatedly squashed by Hudson.

videos.title: Masters Of Klutzfu
videos.overview: Fergy and Paulie decide to learn martial arts to fend off kids at parties. However, since finding that Petunia Pretztail's style, Petunia Fu, is exclusive to her, they develop their own martial art, Klutz Fu.
